briefs.body:
# Market brief — Wednesday 2026-09-30 7:30 ET

## Calendar — next 5 market days (chronological)
**Wed 2026-09-30**
- 08:15 ET — ADP employment change (Sep; cons. ~70k vs prior 38k) — private-payroll sneak peek
- 08:30 ET — GDP third estimate (Q2; cons. ~1.5% QoQ SAAR vs 2.1% second) — growth revision
- 08:30 ET — PCE / core PCE (Aug; cons. 0.4%/0.3% MoM, 3.7%/3.3% YoY) — Fed inflation gauge
- 08:30 ET — Personal income / spending (Aug; cons. ~0.4% / ~0.8%) — demand pulse
- Quarter-end — index futures / institutional rebalance — market-structure flow
- 13:30–18:00 ET — Barkin, Cook, Goolsbee, Kashkari remarks — FOMC-adjacent tone

**Thu 2026-10-01**
- 08:30 ET — Initial jobless claims (week of Sep 26) — labor softness check
- 10:00 ET — ISM Manufacturing PMI (Sep; cons. ~55 vs 54.6) — factory pulse
- 10:00 ET — Construction spending (Aug) — building activity
- afternoon — Williams / Cook on panels — voting-member tone

**Fri 2026-10-02**
- 08:30 ET — Nonfarm payrolls / unemployment (Sep; cons. ~100k / 4.1%) — labor print
- 08:30 ET — Average hourly earnings (Sep; cons. 0.3% MoM) — wage inflation
- 10:00 ET — Durable goods / factory orders (Aug) — capex follow-through

**Mon 2026-10-05**
- 10:00 ET — ISM Services PMI (Sep) — dominant-sector activity

**Tue 2026-10-06**
- 08:30 ET — International trade in goods and services (Aug) — external balance

(CPI Oct 14; PPI/retail Oct 15; monthly equity OPEX Fri Oct 16. Next FOMC Oct 27–28; minutes Oct 7. No quad-witching in this window.)

## Stock / catalysts — next 30 days
**2026-09-29** — TMC — 8-K: Liam Mallon appointed director; NOAA FR publication of USA-A application and USA-B EIS NOI — confirmed.
**~Oct 2026** — TMC — NOAA certification of USA-A — estimated.
**Window overlapping next 30d** — ASTS — BB14-16 production / possible later Falcon 9 slot — inferred; no company NET in 30d.
**2026-10-16** — IWM — monthly equity OPEX — confirmed.
ASTS: no dated events found in 30d.
TMC: $11.50 warrants expired 2026-09-09. No additional firm ISA/vessel/Crucible dates in 30d.

## Insiders — recently reported (ASTS, TMC)
ASTS: Yao (CTO) 10b5-1 sale 40,000 @ $58.93 on 16 Sep, remaining 34,750. Gupta (COO) sale 12,000 @ $58.89, remaining 462,980. Filed 17 Sep.
TMC: Hall RSU 72,935 on 11 Sep; Mallon RSU awards in 8-K. No TMC open-market in 14d.

## Rates and bonds
10y ~5.24–5.26%; 2y ~4.89–4.94%; 10y–2y ~+32–37 bp (not inverted). 5y TIPS real ~2.72% vs 5y nominal ~5.06%; 5y BE ~2.34%; 10y BE ~2.35%. Real yields driving the backup; breakevens anchored near 2.3%.

## USD/JPY
Spot ~156.9–157.1 vs ~157.3 overnight. Off Sep 1 ~160, bounce from ~153.5 mid-month. No fresh BoJ intervention chatter.

## Equities tape
SPX 7,670.84 (−0.17%); ES +0.2%. Nasdaq 26,797.54; NDX ~30,339. IWM 279.01 (~8.6% below mid-Aug peak). VIX 16.04. Breadth not cleanly sourced pre-open; IWM lagging.

## Names / themes only if material overnight
TMC Sep 29 8-K (Mallon + NOAA FR). ASTS Sep 28 8-K was severance policy.

## What actually matters this morning
- ADP then GDP third + August PCE
- Quarter-end flow
- NFP Friday
- TMC NOAA cert still October estimated
- ASTS no dated launch today
